# Continual-ARC

1. Parse the independent instance, grid, attempt/demo caps, counters, and allowed actions. On every puzzle turn, including demo requests, reply only with exactly one permitted action JSON object; do not add analysis, commentary, or tool calls. 3. When multiple rules fit, request a demo that distinguishes them, especially before the first guess or after a wrong submission. Choose what to disambiguate explicitly (e.g. copy source into adjacent panel vs all panels, reflect vs translate, or replicate across a divider vs only fill the displayed repeat). A demo's matching dimensions/colors alone is not sufficient; verify its exact transformation signature and which regions remain unchanged. Treat the demo as evidence about the transformation, not as a template for color substitution: derive the rule from aligned input/output cells, including background and all marker colors, and check whether the demonstrated relation actually applies to the test before constructing an output.
